targetIncarnation: Crash Bandicoot4 It’s About Time(2020), base Toys for Bob design from actual official Activision screenshots/keyart

findings.finding: Selected sprite remains recognizable Crash but uses a more compact classic-style head/torso and short narrow jagged hair tufts, unlike the broad flowing red-orange swept tuft and larger rounded expressive eye/muzzle proportions documented for Crash4.
findings.limit: No exact earlier game incarnation is inferred from resemblance; it is a project-generated rendering, not an official historical Crash model.

findings.finding: Selected blue cropped trousers and small red shoes broadly preserve Crash colors but do not establish the specific broad light rolled denim cuffs and rounded broad-toe sneaker design seen in official Crash4 reveal01.
findings.limit: Small pixel-art seam and lace details cannot be certified1:1.

findings.finding: Selected nose is rendered mostly black/grey while the official keyart uses a warm dark-maroon nose.
findings.limit: Lighting can darken the official nose too; this color alone is not used to establish incarnation divergence.

framingObservation.initialHypothesis: Whole-sheet glance suggested possible last-row top overlap.
framingObservation.result: No cropped hair/ears/shoes observed in the actual frame12 technical crop; initial suspicion is not confirmed for this checked cell.
framingObservation.limit: Detailed individual packing was checked only for frames00 and12; no claim that all16 cells pass or fail packing.

recommendation: Keep the current sprite as the selected historical project variant until a separately reviewed Crash4 atlas replacement is produced from the official source set; preserve the old bytes as a selectable prior variant. Root scheduled any new atlas work after Neris/current lot.
